pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal regions with sharp edge gradients and high angularity. Spatial area of individual patches is significantly greater than the area of the surrounding corridor network.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected cream-colored lattice forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tripartite. Pathway thickness is narrow and consistent, maintaining connectivity across the visible flank and neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Dorsal mane exhibits a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated profile. Individual bristle clusters create a jagged 1D boundary against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: The tail is positioned in a distinct upward curl, bringing the dark terminal tuft into proximity with the posterior dorsal ridge.
